pages.text: Attachments are optional parts that add extra functionality to a finished automobile. Front attachments mount ahead of the driver; rear attachments mount behind.

pages.title: Front Attachments
pages.text:
Autopilot $(li1)drives the automobile automatically along Autopilot Signs
Mob Controller $(li1)steers toward or away from nearby mobs
Crop Harvester $(li1)harvests crops as you drive over them
Grass Cutter $(li1)clears grass and foliage in your path

pages.title: Rear Attachments
pages.text: Passenger Seat, Chest, Ender Chest and Saddled Barrel for storage and passengers$(br)Crafting Table, Smithing Table, Cartography Table, Loom, Grindstone and Stonecutter as mobile workstations$(br)Banner Post, Backhoe and Paver for utility and construction
